card.name: Frequency words in dosing schedules
card.fires_on: The word completing a dosing-frequency phrase, mostly "daily" after "once", or "drop" after "one" in eye-drop directions. It also fires on "days" in "every 14 days".

card.plain: It lights up on the word that finishes how often a dose is given, such as once daily.
